(Studio: Tom Brokaw) President Bush’s announcement that he will appoint a task force to study the recommendations in the report of the commission investigating the September 11 attacks reported. 
 (Washington: Andrea Mitchell) The urgent need for sharing critical intelligence quickly examined; details given of Congress’s decision to hold hearings during its summer break; examples cited of communication gaps by the FBI. [Senator Joseph LIEBERMAN†- asks how we can go about business as usual.] [9/11 Commission chair Thomas KEAN†, vice chair Lee HAMILTON†- explain the importance of information sharing.] [9/11 Commission John LEHMAN†- comments on communication problems between intelligence agencies.] 
 (Studio: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Washington: Pete Williams) The progress since 9/11 in protecting against a chemical or biological attack examined; details given about protective measures for the Democratic National Convention in Boston and about advances in monitoring. [Homeland Security Assistant Secretary Parney ALBRIGHT†- says we have made outstanding progress.] [Bioterror expert Dr. Sue BAILEY†- notes the shortcomings of the nation’s hospitals.] Bush’s signing of a law providing funding for drug companies to develop antidotes to chemical & biological weapons noted. 
 (Studio: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Elizabeth, New Jersey: Mike Taibbi) Security challenges for small cities, public venues & other “soft targets” featured; scenes shown from Jersey Gardens mall in Elizabeth, New Jersey; details given about inadequate funding. [Jersey Gardens general manager Denise PALAZZO†- worries about security.] [Elizabeth Mayor Christian BOLLWAGE†- comments on not having enough resources.] [New Jersey attorney general Peter C. HARVEY†- says New Jersey is a zone of danger.] [2 SHOPPERS – comment.]

data.segment_title: Decision 2004 / Bush vs. Kerry / African Americans / Bush’s Military Records
data.segment_description: (Studio: Tom Brokaw) Reports introduced.   (White House: David Gregory) President Bush’s address to the National Urban League conference in Detroit, where he appealed for the black vote, featured; details given of the closeness of the presidential race. [BUSH – asks for votes; asks if the Democratic Party takes African American voters for granted.] [Political analyst Charlie COOK†- says undecided voters usually break towards the challenger.]   (Denver: Kelly O’Donnell) Senator John Kerry’s campaign trip to his Denver birthplace featured; map shown of Kerry’s planned tour through battleground states. [Vice presidential candidate Senator John EDWARDS – says Kerry will lead the world, not bully it.] [KERRY – speaks on national security; jokes about being born in the west wing.]   (Studio: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced.   (Pentagon: Jim Miklaszewski) The Pentagon’s release of Bush’s military payroll records that it once said were missing featured; details given about what the records confirm about the gap in his service in the Alabama National Guard.
